lines.en: I find myself heading over to the maid cafe before I even know it to spend some time with one of my niece’s many forms.
lines.zh: 不知不觉间，我发现自己又往女仆咖啡厅走去，去陪我侄女的众多形态之一待一会儿。

lines.en: This form, however, might actually be my favorite.
lines.zh: 不过这个形态，说不定才是我最喜欢的。

lines.en: Because not only does she treat me with the same amount of love and affection she does everywhere else, {i}but she is dressed as a maid,{/i} which immediately makes every girl at least two points better.
lines.zh: 因为她不光像在别处一样用同等分量的爱意待我，{i}还穿着女仆装{/i}——而光是穿上女仆装，任何女孩都立刻高出至少两分。

lines.en: That is a factual statement, for maid cafes would not exist if it was not true.
lines.zh: 这话是事实陈述，因为要是这话不真，女仆咖啡厅根本不会存在。

lines.en: Anyway, the morning shift is dead, so the two of us wind up hanging out on the couch as Ami hams up her role as my servant and hangs on my every word.
lines.zh: 总之上午班没什么客人，我俩就窝在沙发上，Ami 夸张地演着「我的仆人」这个角色，我说什么她都竖着耳朵听。

lines.en: But, being a man of few words, it’s more like she’s hanging on by a thread.
lines.zh: 可我这人话不多，所以更像是她只能吊在一根线上勉强撑着。

lines.en: What little conversation I’m able to muster comes to a halt when she stops and stares into my eyes for an uncomfortable amount of time.
lines.zh: 我好不容易挤出的那点话，在她停下来盯着我的眼睛看了好一段让人不自在的时间后，就断了。

lines.en: Nothing happens after that. Not even a word. It’s just ten or twenty seconds of her looking at me with a mix of appreciation, admiration, and something much darker.
lines.zh: 之后什么也没发生。连一个字都没有。只是她用了十到二十秒，怀着一种混杂了感激、仰慕，以及某种更晦暗的东西看着我。

lines.en: Something that, without any words at all, tells me that I am what keeps her grounded.
lines.zh: 那是某种一句话都不用说就告诉我的东西——我是让她没有飘走的那根线。

lines.en: And that without me, she’d simply fly away.
lines.zh: 以及——没有我，她就会径直飞走。

lines.en: I could just be projecting, though...as some days, I feel that way about her.
lines.zh: 不过也可能只是我在把自己的心思投射上去……毕竟有些日子里，我对她也是那种感觉。

lines.en: But of course, I won’t let her know that.
lines.zh: 但我当然不会让她知道。

lines.en: Her string is tied tightly enough around my neck as is.
lines.zh: 她那根线缠在我脖子上，已经够紧的了。
